scripts.text: Specialized insects live in dark places like dungeons.
scripts.translation: 专门适应环境的昆虫会生活在地下城这样的阴暗地方。

scripts.text: The data to be collected this time are ^4d4dff{0} and {1}^000000, also known as Mineworms.
scripts.translation: 这次要收集的资料来自^4d4dff{0}和{1}^000000，也就是矿坑虫。

scripts.text: Is it very different from the normal Porcellio?
scripts.translation: 它们和普通的三叶铁甲虫差别很大吗？

scripts.text: The world is wide and there are many adventurers.
scripts.translation: 世界很大，冒险者也很多。

scripts.text: Then, please take care of the ^4d4dff{0} and {1}^000000 who appear in the ^4d4dff3rd floor of the Einbech Mine Dungeon^000000!
scripts.translation: 那么请处理^4d4dff{0}和{1}^000000，它们出现在^4d4dff伊恩贝赫矿坑地下城三楼^000000！

scripts.text: {0} and {1} are here on the 3rd floor of the Einbech Mine Dungeon.
scripts.translation: {0}和{1}就在伊恩贝赫矿坑地下城三楼。

scripts.text: Um? That's to be a full-time employee!
scripts.translation: 嗯？这是要转正的意思吗！

scripts.text: Not long ago, I joined Regenschrum as a trainee researcher, but this is what I was appointed for.
scripts.translation: 不久前，我加入雷根舒尔姆成为实习研究员，没想到就被指派了这项工作。

scripts.text: It's about collecting data on mining monsters, so my evaluation depends on that.
scripts.translation: 这是收集矿坑魔物的资料，我的考核就看这项成果了。

scripts.text: And there were constant complaints from the headquarters asking what to do with the mine monsters.
scripts.translation: 总部还不断投诉，问我们打算怎么处理矿坑魔物。

scripts.text: While collecting data, it also regulates the number of individuals. This evaluation is a win-win, a win-win!
scripts.translation: 一边收集资料，一边控制魔物数量。这次考核真是一举两得！

scripts.text: The orders keep pouring in, and everyone who works there is running away... It's a big deal, a big deal.
scripts.translation: 订单一直涌进来，所有在这里工作的人都逃跑了...这可不得了，真是大麻烦。

scripts.text: After all, it would be faster for me to learn the sword! I've only been picking a pickaxe for 10 years, so I'll learn it soon.
scripts.translation: 说到底，还不如让我学剑更快！我拿了10年镐子，很快就能学会用剑了。
